newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish builder Unibud sets IPO price at PLN 10-15.
newsitem.headline: Polish builder Unibud sets IPO price at PLN 10-15.

text.p: Polish construction firm Unibud SA set the issue price of its one million share initial public offering at between 10 and 15 zlotys, the company said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.

Unibud, which seeks a parallel market listing, said the final price would be set by management and announced no later than two days before the subscription period begins for the small investor tranche of 500,000 shares from January 20 to 31.
Large investors can register for at least 21,000 shares in their tranche of 500,000 shares from January 27 to 31.
The issue will be valid if investors subscribe for at least 700,000 shares.
All of Unibud's 1.69 million shares have been approved for public trade.

The company, which is 49.99-percent owned by Budimex, earned net 1.3 million zlotys on 44.1 million zlotys in sales in 1995 and 800,000 zlotys on 30.2 million zlotys over the first six months of 1996.
